entries.title: Credential broker remediation deferral and infrastructure failure
optionalFields: credentialBrokerDeferral: { reason: credential-broker-unready, attempts, observedAt, retryAfter }
remediationPlan.retryHistory[].retryMetadata: { code: credential-refresh-unavailable, state: infrastructure-failed, reason, startHead, endHead, localCommit, workspaceDir, resumeWorkspace }
entries.compatibility: Additive optional evidence using existing pending retry and retryAfter contracts. Broker deferrals and proven credential-only outages do not charge remediation rounds. Other infrastructure refund caps and publication failures retain their existing semantics.
